ios.desc:
Chains — Private Messaging, Reimagined.

Chains is a modern, secure messaging app built for people who value privacy without sacrificing features. Send messages, make calls, share moments, and discover new connections — all wrapped in end-to-end encryption.

End-to-End Encrypted Every message and call is secured with industry-standard E2EE. Only you and the person you're talking to can read your conversations — not even we can.

Rich Messaging Send text, voice messages, photos, GIFs, and emojis. React to messages, reply in threads, and organize chats into custom folders.

HD Voice & Video Calls Crystal-clear one-on-one calls powered by WebRTC. Encrypted end-to-end, with no quality compromise.

Discover & Connect Find new people, follow promotions, and explore curated content in the Discover feed.

Group Chats Create groups with friends, family, or teams. Encrypted group messaging with admin controls and customizable settings.

Send Gifts & Stickers Make conversations more fun with gifts, stickers, and animated reactions.

Premium Features Unlock custom themes, larger file uploads, exclusive stickers, and priority support with Chains Premium.

Privacy First
End-to-end encrypted messages and calls
No ads in your chats
You control who can contact you
Manage active devices and sessions
Two-factor authentication
Available Worldwide Supports 12 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.

Built for Mobile Beautiful, fast, and intuitive — designed from the ground up for iPhone and iPad.

Download Chains today and take back control of your conversations.
